metric_name: 按性别及雇员类别划分的受训雇员百分比
query: 按性别及雇员类别划分的受训雇员百分比 按性别及雇员类别划分的受训雇员百分比 衡量企业培训资源的分配情况。指报告期内参加培训的雇员人数占该类别雇员总人数的百分比，需分别按性别（男、女）及雇员类别（如高级管理层、中级管理层、一般员工）进行细分披露。 A. 披露完整性得分 (权重 50%) 2分：完整披露了性别及所有层级类别的受训百分比。 1分：仅披露了整体受训百分比，或缺少其中一个维度（如缺性别划分）。 0分：未披露具体百分比数据。 B. 数据逻辑与口径得分 (权重 50%) 2分：披露了计算方法，且数据分布逻辑合理（如百分比不应无故超过100%）。 1分：仅给出数字，无计算口径说明。 0分：数据存在逻辑错误或未说明。 受训雇员百分比 培训覆盖率 按性别划分的培训 按雇员类别划分的培训 按职级培训 受训人数占比 员工培训统计 percentage of employees trained training coverage rate training by gender training by employee category training by job level trained employees workforce training statistics 是否按男/女披露受训雇员百分比？ 是否按高级管理层、中级管理层、一般员工等类别披露？ 计算口径与分母（该类别雇员总数）是什么？ 报告期是什么？ 数据是否存在明显逻辑异常（如无故超过100%）？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '按性别及雇员类别划分的受训雇员百分比'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否按男/女披露受训雇员百分比？ 是否按高级管理层、中级管理层、一般员工等类别披露？ 计算口径与分母（该类别雇员总数）是什么？ 报告期是什么？ 数据是否存在明显逻辑异常（如无故超过100%）？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有培训总时长或人均学时；仅有培训课程名称清单；仅有人才发展战略描述；仅有整体受训人数无百分比且无细分；区分：本指标是按性别与雇员类别细分的受训百分比披露；人才储备战略关注继任与高潜计划；平等机会措施关注选拔公平流程，不是培训覆盖率统计。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

To enhance the quality control awareness of our plant staff, we organized quality awareness training. For new staff, the Group updated and prepared the Basic Training Material of New Staff Introduction during the Reporting Period to conduct pre-employment and on-thejob training. Training content includes knowledge on the quality system, proper use of general measurement tools, familiarization on various forms' usage, filling and self-inspection requirements of first inspection forms, requirements for first inspection, shunting and tool changing and management of unqualified products. Self-inspection ability and quality awareness of new staff can be enhanced by systematic training.

results.text: Impro Group has always been committed to ensuring a high standard of corporate governance and continues reviewing and improving corporate internal controls. We have strictly complied with the principles and code provisions of the Corporate Governance Code and Corporate Governance Report (the 'CG Code') as set out in Appendix 14 to the Rules Governing the Listing of Securities on the Stock Exchange. The Board has established the Audit Committee, the Remuneration Committee, the Nomination Committee and the Sustainability Committee. The responsibilities of each committee are clearly divided and coordinated. By formulating business plans and development strategies, discovering new opportunities and overcoming new market challenges, identifying and paying attention to potential risks, and formulating the strategic framework for sustainable development, the committees have jointly safeguarded the corporate and social responsibilities and values of the Group. Board diversity is also one of the elements of the Group's long-term development. The Board has reviewed the diversity policy, and comprehensively considered the candidates of directors in terms of gender, age, cultural and educational background, industry experience, technical and professional skills and/or qualifications, knowledge, length of service and time devoted to performing the duties of directors when designing, reviewing and evaluating the composition of the Board. Currently, female members of the Board account for 25%.
